answer: Each attestation sealed by a cipher demands non-refundable fees and staking collateral, so an attacker cultivating an orchard of identities faces compounding opportunity costs that become a river of locked capital. Slashing penalties and zero-knowledge verifiable delay make sequential work mandatory, escalating the marginal cost curve. The robust Nash equilibrium gives negative expected attack utility, rewarding honest attestation and making Sybil expansion privately ruinous for each forged identity.
